name: Toni Peinoit
headline: Founder @ GoMarketMe
about: 15 years of hands-on experience in the San Francisco Bay Area as a developer, architect, and CTO, with background in digital advertising, marketplace management, and SaaS.

experiences.description:
- Google Maps for Scenic Drives. Get from A to B the most scenic way. No planning required. 
- Available on the App Store and Google Play since February 1st, 2022. 
- Joined the Pioneer accelerator contest in February 2022. Reached the Global TOP 50 within 6 weeks.

- Developed a Natural Language Generation algorithm that adapts to the style and content of training data to produce never-seen-before ad copy at scale
- Designed a modular API framework hosting 150+ microservices specific to ad management, content creation management and external integrations
- Scaled integrations with Google AdWords and Microsoft Advertising Bulk APIs
- Moved core workflows to a serverless infrastructure for 1000x scale while cutting costs
- Developed a data pipeline to ETL terabytes of market place data and Train internal algorithms
- Automated the merge and deployment process by implementing Continuous Development (CD) and Continuous Integration (CI) best practices
- Interviewed, hired and grew QA and DO engineering teams based in India

- Interviewed, hired and grew mobile and DS engineering teams based in Eastern Europe
- Deployed a 5-star app to the App Store
- Gained traction with 50+ publications in nationwide papers including the Los Angeles Times, San Francisco Chronicle and Italian La Stampa
